assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a full-bleed portrait PNG environment backdrop for an illustrated wedding invitation, exactly 1024 x 1536 pixels.

Create a NEW eye-level, medium-wide view of a gothic study, matching the scratchy black-ink linework, irregular hand-drawn cutout storybook shapes, maroon wood, cream highlights and muted candlelight of the supplied references. The feel is Don't Starve Together: austere, whimsical, scratchy and flatly illustrated, never anime, photorealistic, glossy or 3D.

Reference roles: Image 1 is a STYLE AND SETTING reference only. Its oversized foreground table is specifically NOT the composition to copy. Image 2 is ONLY a linework and material-texture reference; do not include a book.

Composition is crucial: show the study at a comfortable human eye level from several paces back. A SMALL, realistically waist-height narrow wooden console stands in the MIDDLE DISTANCE, centered. Its entire width occupies only x=30% to x=70% of the image. Its tabletop is around y=48% of the image, and the feet end around y=68%. It has slim visible carved legs, open empty space below, and an understated cream antique map lying flat on top. The console must look modest in the surrounding room, not monumental, not a foreground desk, not a tall chest, not a solid front-panel counter. Do not add any chair. Keep the whole room visible around it.

A tall gothic window and drapery may sit far left, a narrow bookcase far right, pointed arches and subdued maroon rose ornament in the background. Keep these secondary elements restrained and near the room's outer edges. Warm cream light softly enters from the left.

Substantial spacious EMPTY foreground FLOOR starts around y=60% and fills the full lower 40% down to y=100%, with perspective plank or stone detail in dark maroon, quiet enough for full-body character sprites to be composited later. Except for the small console's narrow legs around y=60–68%, this foreground must be totally unobstructed. Preserve broad clear floor space at center and both sides. No large foreground furniture, no objects cropped into the bottom edge.

No people, no characters, no creatures, no silhouettes, no text, no readable letters, no labels, no UI, no watermarks, no border. One single illustration, not a collage. Deliver a PNG at 1024 x 1536 portrait.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: full-bleed portrait PNG background for an animated guestbook screen, exactly 1024 x 1536 pixels.

Create a NEW TRUE TOP-DOWN CLOSE OVERHEAD view of a dark maroon wooden writing surface. The camera points straight down at 90 degrees. The flat wood surface fills every pixel from edge to edge, with no horizon, room walls, desk legs or perspective tilt.

Reference roles: Image 1 is ONLY a dark maroon gothic palette and scratchy ink material-style reference. Do not reproduce its room, its map or its objects. Image 2 is ONLY a scratchy irregular black-ink storybook-linework reference. The BOOK ITSELF MUST NOT APPEAR. A separate matching PNG book will be animated over this background later; do not draw any book or book-shaped object into this image.

Style: Don't Starve Together scratchy ink-cutout storybook illustration, irregular hand-drawn ink contours and subtle crosshatching, dark wine-red wood grain, black shadows, a few aged-cream candle highlights. Flat illustrated material texture, never anime, not photorealistic, not 3D, not glossy. Quiet gothic atmosphere consistent with the references.

Composition is crucial: the central 75% of the canvas is uninterrupted empty dark maroon wooden surface. Broad horizontal wooden boards may show restrained grain and narrow natural seams. Keep the entire region from x=12.5% to87.5% and y=12.5% to87.5% completely free of objects, graphics, strong marks or cast shadows. This clear central area is where the separate animated book will sit.

Only tiny perimeter accents: a partly cropped short candle with a small warm flame at the extreme upper-left corner, a partly cropped quill at the extreme right edge, and two or three dark maroon rose petals near the extreme bottom-left corner. These accents must remain within the outer 10% margin. Keep them subdued, sparse, and visibly peripheral; their shadows must not extend into the clear center. Candle seen from above, with no frontal scene elements.

ABSOLUTELY NO BOOK, no open book, no closed book, no book outline, no book-shaped frame, no pages, no paper, no parchment, no scroll, no map, no writing, no words, no letters, no symbols, no UI, no labels, no hands, no people, no characters, no watermarks, no decorative border. The center must contain wood and nothing else. One single image, not a collage. Deliver a PNG at 1024 x 1536 portrait.
